title: The National Library of Israel - Shofar Prayer, Ashkenazi version - 1785188 SHOFAR78
author: The National Library of Israel (Music Collection and Sound Archive)
changes: One tekiah blast on a shofar (ram's horn). Trimmed to 54.75–56.25 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
